author: Learn Linux TV
description:
📘 Linux Troubleshooting Strategies ebook: https://learnlinux.link/sysadmin-ebook

Ubuntu runs GNOME, but not stock GNOME. Canonical adds its own dock, theme and other tweaks. In this video, I’ll show you how to install a vanilla GNOME session on Ubuntu so you can log in to GNOME the way the upstream developers intended. After that, we’ll go over a few more ways to debloat Ubuntu and make it your own.
